description:
Source issue: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/834
Parent contract: zaq-zqq (read before implementation).

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Inspect current baseline and existing tests before any behavior-changing edits. Audit evidence: test/zaq/agent/history_loader_test.exs expects stored-name prefixes and some bare assistant contents; test/zaq/agent/tools/accounts/history_test.exs around the flattened-list case expects role/content-only maps. Executor, InputPrompt, RequestControl and Factory suites also need exact expectation inventory. Present old versus new assertions/scenarios for header/time changes, unknown legacy authors, added projection fields, and Factory prompt composition. Obtain explicit human approval and record approver, source and exact scope in Beadwork; do not treat task creation as approval. Confirm #835 remains in the implementation baseline.
Tests to add before implementation: this is an approval/planning gate, not a test-edit task. Inventory regression tests for all downstream tasks; do not weaken assertions or silently rewrite fixtures to manufacture author evidence.
Branches/paths validated: existing exact text assertions, nested/flat search shapes, persisted versus unpersisted timestamp semantics, native assistant/tool roles. Clarify any conflict before implementation.
Mocking plan: not applicable; inspection only.
Documentations to update: record the approved test-change matrix in this issue and link it from affected child issues; no application-doc changes required.
Action reuse assessment: not applicable; no operation is implemented. Downstream work extends Conversations, People and existing History Action rather than creating parallel operations.
Acceptance: explicit approval evidence exists for every known existing-test behavior change. New unforeseen expectation changes must pause for further approval.

Implementation-start audit (2026-10-15): checkout clean on main. User said "Go ahead" to delivery; this is not recorded as explicit approval of the test expectation changes below. Await specific approval before closing this gate.

Existing-test behavior approval matrix:
1. test/zaq/agent/history_loader_test.exs:38,66,95,120-121 and other exact rendered-content assertions: stored channel labels such as Alice (alice): / Author (source): and bare restored assistant bodies -> agreed Author + Sent at/Recorded at + Message text header from domain metadata. Legacy fixtures without reliable Person linkage -> Unknown author, not conversation owner or fabricated directory fixture. Preserve original body, attachments, order, roles, refs, dedup and private-trace exclusion assertions.
2. test/zaq/agent/tools/accounts/history_test.exs:488-492: exact flat role/content-only maps -> same chronological messages with additive structured author and timestamp/provenance. Nested output must match. Preserve counts, scope, raw content and unauthorized assertions.
3. test/zaq/agent/factory_test.exs:241 and 578 (exact prompt equality), plus any equivalent exact configured-prompt expectations: job-only text -> original configured job/skill content plus one shared header interpretation instruction through existing Factory/Jido prompt integration. Preserve overrides, skills, hidden skill-body and prompt dedup assertions.
4. test/zaq/agent/executor_test.exs and existing immediate/queued/steering/provider integration scenarios: processing-time prefix or bare model-bound persisted body -> agreed header using persisted provider_sent_at else inserted_at labeled Recorded at. Non-persisted inputs without trusted source time have no timestamp. Original raw admission/content, permission and attachment contracts unchanged. Existing nonbinary passthrough test at 1025 is outside requested change and should remain intact.
5. InputPrompt.append_attachments tests retain behavior; add render_message tests rather than changing attachment-only helper contract. RequestControl existing access/receipt tests retain behavior; add model-payload assertions. Existing runtime lifecycle/state tests remain unchanged except specifically disclosed rendered-payload expectations; do not introduce author/time refs or rename refresh.

If implementation identifies any expectation change outside this disclosed matrix, pause that change for separate approval. No test files or application files have been modified.


Explicit approval received from user Julien in this session: "Yes it's approved", in direct response to the disclosed existing-test expectation matrix (HistoryLoader headers/unknown legacy authors, search additive author/time fields, Factory explanatory prompt, Executor persisted Sent at/Recorded at or absent non-persisted time). Approved scope is that matrix only; preserve permissions/raw admission/attachments/tool calls/order/dedup and seek approval for new behavioral changes.
title: [#834] Approve exact test-contract changes and confirm delivery baseline
